name: Shell and theme regressions
command:
python3 -B - <<'PY'
import pathlib, subprocess, tempfile
logs = pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='dots-tmux-checks-'))
print('Full logs:', logs, flush=True)
checks = [
 ['python3', '-B', 'tools/test_common.py'],
 ['python3', '-B', 'tools/test_shell_init.py'],
 ['python3', '-B', 'tools/test_bash_dots.py'],
 ['python3', '-B', 'tools/test_zsh.py'],
 ['python3', '-B', 'tools/test_themes.py'],
 ['python3', '-B', 'tools/test_theme_workflow.py'],
 ['python3', '-B', 'tools/bash_interactive.py'],
 ['python3', '-B', 'tools/zsh_interactive.py', '--samples', '3'],
]
failed = False
for args in checks:
 name = pathlib.Path(args[2]).stem
 try:
  p = subprocess.run(args, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=240)
  text = p.stdout + p.stderr
  (logs / (name + '.log')).write_text(text)
  print(name, 'PASS' if p.returncode == 0 else 'FAIL', 'exit', p.returncode, flush=True)
  print(text[-3500:] if p.returncode else text[-900:], flush=True)
  failed |= bool(p.returncode)
 except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
  print(name, 'TIMEOUT', flush=True)
  failed = True
raise SystemExit(1 if failed else 0)
PY
